meta.title: Signal flow, stage to stream
meta.intro: Read it left to right: stage sources feed the stage racks, everything meets on the Dante network in the middle, and the console, switcher and lighting desk send to speakers, screens and the stream.
meta.footnote: Arrows show signal direction. Dashed borders are planned (phase 2) equipment.
meta.description: Fathom 0.3 sample: three rooms (auditorium, chapel, broadcast suite) with audio, video, lighting, network and control.
